class ResourceAllocator {
  constructor() {
    this.agentPool = new Map();
    this.missionPriorities = new Map();
  }

  async allocateResources(missionId, requiredCapabilities) {
    const availableAgents = this.findAvailableAgents(requiredCapabilities);
    const missionPriority = this.missionPriorities.get(missionId) || 1;
    
    // Sort agents by suitability and availability
    const sortedAgents = availableAgents.sort((a, b) => {
      const aScore = this.calculateAgentScore(a, missionPriority);
      const bScore = this.calculateAgentScore(b, missionPriority);
      return bScore - aScore;
    });

    return sortedAgents.slice(0, requiredCapabilities.length);
  }

  calculateAgentScore(agent, missionPriority) {
    const performanceScore = agent.performanceMetrics?.revenueGenerated || 0;
    const availabilityScore = agent.currentLoad < 0.8 ? 1 : 0.5;
    const specializationScore = this.calculateSpecializationScore(agent);
    
    return performanceScore * availabilityScore * specializationScore * missionPriority;
  }
}

  constructor() {

    this.conversionRates = new Map();
    this.customerAcquisitionCosts = new Map();

      totalRevenue: 0,
      transactions: [],
      conversionRate: 0
    };

    stream.totalRevenue += revenueData.amount;
    stream.transactions.push({
      amount: revenueData.amount,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      source: revenueData.source
    });

    this.revenueStreams.set(missionId, stream);
    await this.updateConversionRates(missionId);
  }

  async optimizePricing(missionId) {
    const stream = this.revenueStreams.get(missionId);
    if (!stream) return null;

    const avgTransactionValue = stream.totalRevenue / stream.transactions.length;
    const conversionRate = this.conversionRates.get(missionId) || 0;

    // Simple pricing optimization logic
    if (conversionRate < 0.02 && avgTransactionValue > 50) {
      return { action: 'DECREASE_PRICE', percentage: 10 };
    } else if (conversionRate > 0.05 && avgTransactionValue < 20) {
      return { action: 'INCREASE_PRICE', percentage: 15 };
    }

    return { action: 'MAINTAIN_PRICE' };
  }
}

      'Eco-friendly products',
      'Mental health digital products',
      'Pet accessories',
      'Home office equipment'
    ];

    const scoredNiches = niches.map(niche => ({
      niche,
      score: this.calculateNicheScore(niche, marketData)
    }));

    return scoredNiches
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .map(item => item.niche);
  }

  calculateNicheScore(niche, marketData) {
    const demand = marketData.demandScores[niche] || 0;
    const competition = marketData.competitionScores[niche] || 1;
    const profitMargin = marketData.profitMargins[niche] || 0.5;
    
    return (demand * profitMargin) / competition;
  }
}

The message bus supports different communication patterns including publish-subscribe for general announcements, request-response for specific queries, and event-driven notifications for time-sensitive actions.

// Advanced Message Bus Communication System
class SwarmMessageBus {
  constructor() {
    this.subscribers = new Map();
    this.messageQueue = [];
    this.processing = false;
  }

  subscribe(agentId, messageType, handler) {
    if (!this.subscribers.has(messageType)) {
      this.subscribers.set(messageType, new Map());
    }
    this.subscribers.get(messageType).set(agentId, handler);
  }

  async publish(message) {
    this.messageQueue.push({
      ...message,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      id: this.generateMessageId()
    });

    if (!this.processing) {
      this.processMessageQueue();
    }
  }

  async processMessageQueue() {
    this.processing = true;
    
    while (this.messageQueue.length > 0) {
      const message = this.messageQueue.shift();
      await this.deliverMessage(message);
    }
    
    this.processing = false;
  }

  async deliverMessage(message) {
    const subscribers = this.subscribers.get(message.type);
    
    if (subscribers) {
      const deliveryPromises = Array.from(subscribers.entries()).map(
        ([agentId, handler]) => handler(message, agentId)
      );
      
      await Promise.allSettled(deliveryPromises);
    }
  }

  generateMessageId() {
    return `msg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  }
}

// Agent Coordination Manager
class AgentCoordinationManager {
  constructor(messageBus) {
    this.messageBus = messageBus;
    this.agentRegistry = new Map();
    this.coordinationStrategies = new Map();
    this.performanceMonitor = new PerformanceMonitor();
  }

  registerAgent(agent) {
    this.agentRegistry.set(agent.id, {
      ...agent,
      status: 'active',
      lastActivity: new Date(),
      currentTasks: []
    });

    // Subscribe agent to relevant message types
    this.setupAgentSubscriptions(agent);
  }

  setupAgentSubscriptions(agent) {
    // All agents subscribe to system messages
    this.messageBus.subscribe(agent.id, 'SYSTEM_UPDATE', agent.handleSystemMessage);
    
    // Subscribe to mission-specific messages
    if (agent.capabilities.includes('content_creation')) {
      this.messageBus.subscribe(agent.id, 'CONTENT_REQUEST', agent.handleContentRequest);
    }
    
    if (agent.capabilities.includes('seo_optimization')) {
      this.messageBus.subscribe(agent.id, 'SEO_OPTIMIZATION', agent.handleSEOOptimization);
    }
    
    if (agent.capabilities.includes('email_automation')) {
      this.messageBus.subscribe(agent.id, 'EMAIL_CAMPAIGN', agent.handleEmailCampaign);
    }
  }

  async coordinateMission(missionId, objective) {
    const strategy = this.coordinationStrategies.get(missionId) || 
                    await this.createCoordinationStrategy(missionId, objective);
    
    await this.executeCoordinationStrategy(strategy);
  }

  async createCoordinationStrategy(missionId, objective) {
    const strategy = {
      missionId,
      objective,
      agentRoles: new Map(),
      communicationFlow: [],
      successCriteria: [],
      fallbackStrategies: []
    };

    // Define agent roles based on mission requirements
    const requiredCapabilities = this.identifyRequiredCapabilities(objective);
    const availableAgents = this.findAgentsWithCapabilities(requiredCapabilities);
    
    for (const [capability, agents] of Object.entries(availableAgents)) {
      const selectedAgent = this.selectBestAgent(agents, capability);
      strategy.agentRoles.set(capability, selectedAgent.id);
    }

    // Define communication flow
    strategy.communicationFlow = this.defineCommunicationFlow(strategy.agentRoles);
    
    this.coordinationStrategies.set(missionId, strategy);
    return strategy;
  }

  async executeCoordinationStrategy(strategy) {
    const { missionId, agentRoles, communicationFlow } = strategy;
    
    // Initialize mission coordination
    await this.messageBus.publish({
      type: 'MISSION_START',
      missionId,
      agentRoles: Object.fromEntries(agentRoles),
      timestamp: new Date()
    });

    // Execute communication flow
    for (const step of communicationFlow) {
      await this.executeCommunicationStep(step);
    }
  }
}

// Performance Monitoring and Adaptive Optimization
class PerformanceMonitor {
  constructor() {
    this.metrics = new Map();
    this.thresholds = new Map();
    this.alerts = [];
  }

  async trackMetric(agentId, metricName, value) {
    const key = `${agentId}:${metricName}`;
    const history = this.metrics.get(key) || [];
    
    history.push({
      value,
      timestamp: new Date()
    });

    // Keep only last 100 measurements
    if (history.length > 100) {
      history.shift();
    }

    this.metrics.set(key, history);
    await this.checkThresholds(agentId, metricName, value);
  }

  async checkThresholds(agentId, metricName, value) {
    const threshold = this.thresholds.get(`${agentId}:${metricName}`);
    
    if (threshold && this.evaluateThreshold(value, threshold)) {
      this.alerts.push({
        agentId,
        metricName,
        value,
        threshold,
        timestamp: new Date(),
        severity: threshold.severity
      });

      await this.handleAlert(agentId, metricName, value, threshold);
    }
  }

  async handleAlert(agentId, metricName, value, threshold) {
    // Implement adaptive response strategies
    if (threshold.action === 'SCALE_RESOURCES') {
      await this.scaleAgentResources(agentId, value);
    } else if (threshold.action === 'OPTIMIZE_CONFIG') {
      await this.optimizeAgentConfiguration(agentId, metricName);
    }
  }

  generatePerformanceReport(agentId) {
    const agentMetrics = {};
    
    for (const [key, history] of this.metrics.entries()) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${agentId}:`)) {
        const metricName = key.split(':')[1];
        const recentValues = history.slice(-10); // Last 10 measurements
        
        agentMetrics[metricName] = {
          current: recentValues[recentValues.length - 1]?.value,
          average: recentValues.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0) / recentValues.length,
          trend: this.calculateTrend(recentValues)
        };
      }
    }
    
    return agentMetrics;
  }
}

class FinancialRiskManager {
  constructor() {
    this.transactionLimits = new Map();
    this.fraudDetection = new FraudDetectionSystem();
    this.cashFlowManager = new CashFlowManager();
  }

  async assessTransactionRisk(transaction) {
    const riskFactors = [];
    
    // Amount risk assessment
    if (transaction.amount > this.getHighValueThreshold(transaction.currency)) {
      riskFactors.push('HIGH_VALUE_TRANSACTION');
    }

    // Frequency risk assessment
    const recentTransactions = await this.getRecentTransactions(transaction.sender);
    if (recentTransactions.length > 10) {
      riskFactors.push('HIGH_FREQUENCY_TRANSACTIONS');
    }

    // Geographic risk assessment
    if (this.isHighRiskLocation(transaction.location)) {
      riskFactors.push('HIGH_RISK_LOCATION');
    }

    // Fraud detection
    const fraudScore = await this.fraudDetection.assessFraudRisk(transaction);
    if (fraudScore > 0.7) {
      riskFactors.push('POTENTIAL_FRAUD');
    }

    return {
      riskLevel: this.calculateRiskLevel(riskFactors, fraudScore),
      riskFactors,
      recommendation: this.generateRiskRecommendation(riskFactors, fraudScore)
    };
  }

  calculateRiskLevel(riskFactors, fraudScore) {
    const riskScore = riskFactors.length * 0.2 + fraudScore;
    
    if (riskScore >= 0.8) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (riskScore >= 0.6) return 'HIGH';
    if (riskScore >= 0.4) return 'MEDIUM';
    return 'LOW';
  }

  generateRiskRecommendation(riskFactors, fraudScore) {
    if (fraudScore > 0.8) return 'REJECT_AND_INVESTIGATE';
    if (fraudScore > 0.6) return 'MANUAL_REVIEW';
    if (riskFactors.length > 2) return 'ADDITIONAL_VERIFICATION';
    return 'APPROVE';
  }
}

      'RESPOND_PROMPTLY',
      'BE_TRANSPARENT',
      'RESPECT_CUSTOMER_RIGHTS',
      'MAINTAIN_PROFESSIONALISM'
    ]);
  }

  async auditAgentBehavior(agentId, activity) {
    const guidelines = this.guidelines.get(activity.category) || [];
    const violations = [];

    for (const guideline of guidelines) {
      const isViolation = await this.auditor.checkViolation(activity, guideline);
      if (isViolation) {
        violations.push(guideline);
      }
    }

    return {
      ethical: violations.length === 0,
      violations,
      score: this.calculateEthicalScore(violations.length, guidelines.length)
    };
  }

  calculateEthicalScore(violations, totalGuidelines) {
    return totalGuidelines > 0 ? (totalGuidelines - violations) / totalGuidelines : 1;
  }
}

// Initialize risk management systems
const complianceManager = new ComplianceManager();
const financialRiskManager = new FinancialRiskManager();
const ethicalGuidelinesManager = new EthicalGuidelinesManager();

// Example: Validating agent actions
async function validateAgentAction(agentId, platform, action) {
  // Compliance check
  const complianceResult = await complianceManager.validateAgentAction(agentId, platform, action);
  
  // Financial risk assessment (if applicable)
  let financialRisk = null;
  if (action.type === 'TRANSACTION') {
    financialRisk = await financialRiskManager.assessTransactionRisk(action);
  }

  // Ethical guidelines check
  const ethicalAudit = await ethicalGuidelinesManager.auditAgentBehavior(agentId, action);

  // Combined decision
  const isApproved = complianceResult.compliant && 
                     (!financialRisk || financialRisk.recommendation === 'APPROVE') && 
                     ethicalAudit.ethical;

  return {
    approved: isApproved,
    compliance: complianceResult,
    financialRisk,
    ethical: ethicalAudit
  };
}
